params.text:
The best GAN Python implementation I found is the PyTorch-GAN repository by Erik Linder-Norén. This is a comprehensive collection of PyTorch implementations of various Generative Adversarial Network varieties presented in research papers. It has 45 stars, MIT license, and contains implementations of 30+ different GAN architectures.

SSH clone command:
```bash
git clone ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2222/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN.git
```

Repository details:
- Platform: GitLab
- Owner: Erik Linder-Norén
- Description: PyTorch implementations of Generative Adversarial Networks
- License: MIT License
- Commits: 193
- Branches: 25
- Size: 169.9 MB
- Stars: 45

Note: The repository author mentions it has gone stale as they don't have time to maintain it anymore, but it remains a comprehensive collection of GAN implementations.
